Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for the claim file. Can you please
state your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Conroe, heading straight through on a green light as far as I could tell.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from my right side pulled out into the intersection. I hit my brakes, but it was too late. Their front
end caught the driver's side of my car.
Q: Were you able to see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Only for a second. It came out from behind a parked van, so I didn't have much time to react.
Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?
A: We exchanged information. They seemed shaken up, and they said they didn't see my car utnil the last moment.
Q: How are you feeling physically since the collision?
A: My neck is pretty stiff and sore. I felt it the next morning, and turning my head to check my blind spot hurts. I've
been using a heating pad and taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you sought medical attention?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the day after. They diagnosed a neck strain and told me to rest and follow up with my
primary doctor if it doesn't improve.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send over any paperwork you need. Thank you.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
